From film producer to tech investor may not seem like the most natural of evolutions. But for Jeffrey Katzenberg, it wasn’t a stretch. In this Crunchbase News interview, he and WndrCo general partner Justin Wexler share their thoughts on what’s next when it comes to enterprise AI and how storytelling can be a competitive advantage.
